speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twenty. He said two hundred. The town's whole affliction, he says, and this year twenty.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The two pounds stay out. I did not ask them, and I will not lend.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Ten quarters, dry. A sheet with never a blot. He made them shine a little. The supper has no day.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The letter is still on the board. No answer.
